findings.message: the model identified additional risk; it can only raise the decision to REVIEW
some scheduled Pods have no CPU/memory requests and are treated as zero; free capacity may be overstated
one or more relevant alerts are firing
traffic is too low to treat observed zero errors or latency as healthy

ai_risks.detail: The pod template changes spec.template.spec.containers[0].env[0].value and env[1].value, but both old and new values are redacted, so the diff cannot be verified. Trusted cases show fault-injection env values are drill-only: DEMO_STARTUP_FAIL=true causes new Pods to CrashLoop (release protection, not a healthy release), and DEMO_ERROR_RATE=1 makes real requests return 500. Require the rendered values to be the normal production values (e.g. DEMO_ERROR_RATE=0, no startup-fail flag) before merge.
ai_risks.title: Redacted env value changes may ship drill fault settings

ai_risks.detail: KubeCPUOvercommit is firing and 35 scheduled Pods have no CPU/memory requests, so reported free capacity (2190m CPU) may be overstated. With maxUnavailable: 0 / maxSurge: 1 the rollout needs room for a surge Pod alongside the retained old Pod; verify capacity before syncing.
ai_risks.title: Capacity headroom uncertain during rollout

ai_risks.detail: request_rate is 0 and error_ratio/p95 are null, so a successful rollout cannot be judged healthy from metrics alone; verify the new image digest and /version after sync.
ai_risks.title: No traffic-based health signal

review.ai_redacted_env_risk: REFUTED by exact base/head blob comparison: the diff changes only image.tag, image.digest, appVersion and gitSha; APP_ENV and DEMO_ERROR_RATE lines are unchanged context, so no fault-injection env change is shipped. AI saw redacted env values and speculated.
review.capacity_risk: ACCEPTED as a known REVIEW limitation. The rollout may have limited headroom (35 pods without requests, KubeCPUOvercommit firing); postdeploy verification must prove readiness and digest/version, not just no errors.
review.low_traffic_risk: ACCEPTED as a known REVIEW limitation. A bounded 2 rps traffic warmup is required to fill the 5m rate window before postdeploy verification; zero traffic is not treated as PASS.
review.scope: Only gitops/demo/values.yaml changes, from current main; chart pin unchanged; required CI success is bound to the head and app id 15368.
